meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后，当你询问某个任务怎么做或有没有现成技能时，它会去搜索开放技能库（skills.sh），核对安装量和来源后给出技能名、安装命令和链接，并可帮你直接安装。
howto.when: 当你问“怎么做某件事”“找某个技能”，或表示想扩展 Claude 能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我找个能让 React 应用变快的技能。
say.note: 它会搜索并推荐相关技能及安装命令。

say.text: 有没有能做 PR review 的技能？
say.note: 它会核对安装量和来源后给出推荐。

say.text: 帮我搜索 changelog 相关的技能。
say.note: 它会运行搜索并展示结果。

howto.what_en: When enabled, if you ask how to do a task or whether a skill exists, Claude searches the open skills ecosystem (skills.sh), checks install counts and source reputation, then shows skill names, install commands and links, and can install the skill for you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how to do something, look for a skill for a task, or express interest in extending capabilities.

say_en.text: Help me find a skill to speed up my React app.
say_en.note: Claude searches and recommends skills with install commands.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for PR review?
say_en.note: It checks install counts and sources before recommending.
Runs a skill search and shows results.
